name: Cable Rope Triceps Pushdown
steps: Face a high cable rope and grasp an end in each hand with your elbows bent beside your ribs.
Extend both elbows and let the ends separate beside your thighs.
Bring your hands back up with control.
tips: Keep your upper arms still as the rope ends move apart.
Keep your torso upright and avoid letting your shoulders roll forward at the bottom.
